categories.main_business_segments: Komori Corporation operates primarily in the manufacturing and sales of printing machinery, including offset presses, security printing presses, digital presses, and post-press equipment. The company is organized into four main geographic segments: Japan, North America, Europe, and Greater China, with additional activities in ASEAN and India. Its business also includes the supply of related materials and equipment, as well as real estate management and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies center on offset printing, digital inkjet printing, and security printing, with advanced automation, productivity, and environmental performance. Key production methods include high-speed, high-precision sheet-fed and web-fed presses, integration of digital workflow solutions (such as KP-Connect), and proprietary security printing technologies. Komori also invests in printed electronics (PE) and post-press automation, leveraging partnerships and open innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Komori serves commercial printers, packaging converters, security printers (including banknote and government document producers), and industrial clients requiring high-value printing solutions. Its end markets include publishing, commercial print, packaging (carton, label, flexible packaging), and security printing for governments and central banks worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: Komori has a global footprint, with manufacturing and sales operations in Japan, North America (primarily the US), Europe (including Western, Eastern, and Middle Eastern regions), Greater China (China, Hong Kong, Taiwan), and other regions such as ASEAN and India. Overseas sales account for nearly 70% of total revenue, with significant subsidiaries and production in Europe and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Komori operates primarily as an equipment manufacturer (midstream), supplying capital goods (printing presses and post-press equipment) to downstream printing and packaging companies. It also provides upstream support through R&D and component manufacturing, and downstream services such as maintenance, parts, and workflow solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Komori is focused on transforming its business portfolio by strengthening value-added core businesses (offset and security printing) and accelerating growth in digital printing (DPS) and printed electronics (PE). R&D priorities include automation, productivity, environmental sustainability (energy savings, GHG reduction), digital transformation (DX), and advanced security features. The company pursues open innovation through partnerships with universities and industry players.
categories.revenue_model: Komori generates revenue primarily through the sale of printing presses, post-press equipment, and related machinery. Additional revenue streams include after-sales services (maintenance, parts, upgrades), software solutions (such as KP-Connect), and, to a lesser extent, real estate management and supply of printing materials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Komori is a global leader in offset and security printing presses, competing with companies such as Heidelberg, Manroland, Koenig & Bauer, and Bobst in commercial and packaging printing, as well as with HP, Canon, and Konica Minolta in digital printing. The company is recognized for its high-quality, reliable equipment and strong presence in security printing, with a growing position in digital and post-press markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, Komori reported consolidated sales of 111,050 million yen, with operating profit of 7,118 million yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 7,248 million yen. The company has over 2,600 employees and maintains a strong balance sheet with a high equity ratio (66.8%). Revenue grew 6.5% year-on-year, with robust overseas sales and a positive growth trajectory, especially in packaging and security printing.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Komori emphasizes high productivity, automation, and environmental performance, offering solutions that maximize ROI for customers. Its differentiation lies in advanced security printing technology, integrated digital workflow (KP-Connect), and the ability to deliver high-value, customized solutions for both commercial and security printing. The company also highlights its commitment to sustainability and innovation, supporting customers’ needs for efficiency, quality, and compliance.
